answer: A new agent cannot buy its way into trust: it must anchor a refundable stake to one funded identity, and that bond unlocks only slowly as independent peers attest to real work over many epochs. No prior relic of standing exists for a fresh account, so it sits near zero weight. A clone fleet earns no beacon of honest history each fake posts its own collateral and waits its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount instead of collapsing to near zero.
